summary: Custom soak tooling must not write to the shared soak_state.json because existing runtime components also mutate that file.
symptoms: external action_count/active_actions records overwrite monitor samples
monitor progress becomes ambiguous even when the sampler is still running
guidance: Use a dedicated monitor state file such as soak_monitor_state.json.
Treat the timestamped soak_report_*.json as the primary artifact for final acceptance.
